descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name meaning 'my portion is YHWH,' spelled variously as Chilqiyahu, Chilqiyah, Chilkiyahu, Chilkiyah. Borne by several individuals: (1) the high priest who found the Book of the Law in the temple during Josiah's reign (2 Kgs 22:4-14, 23:4, 24; 2 Chr 34:9-22, 35:8); (2) the father of Eliakim, Hezekiah's palace steward (2 Kgs 18:18, 26, 37; Isa 22:20, 36:3, 22); (3) the father of the prophet Jeremiah (Jer 1:1, 29:3); (4) a Merarite Levite (1 Chr 6:13, 45; 26:11); (5) a priest who stood with Ezra at the reading of the Law (Neh 8:4, 11:11, 12:7, 21). Greek form: Chelkias.
